conflicts.summary: Main already contains two question-key registries with disjoint keys. Pipeline extraction emits taxonomy.py keys. Curation approval and the trend catalog require a different key set. Canonical export copies the pipeline key through unchanged.

reproducible_example.export_path: pipeline/pdoom_pipeline/export/corpus.py copies statement question_key with no translation
reproducible_example.approval_rule: docs/CURATION.md requires the question key to be one of QUESTION_TAXONOMY

conflicts.requested_resolution: Agent 2 publishes one registry and an explicit mapping or replacement for pipeline keys. Agent 5 and Agent 3 consume that registry. Agent 7 will not invent a third taxonomy or silently retarget keys during integration.
conflicts.integration_rule: Do not merge extraction output into the product trend path until this mapping is explicit in the included commits.
conflicts.measurement: coordination/reproductions/results-2026-10-04T203514Z.json question_keys. overlap is empty. exported_key_in_product_taxonomy is false.

conflicts.summary: The in-memory observation store keeps a new hash as a new version. export_corpus emits one slug per canonical URL, always content_version 1, and changed_count 0. Two observations of the same URL in one export produce two source items with the same slug. The importer upserts source items by slug, so a later import replaces the hash instead of retaining the previous version row.

reproducible_example.importer: packages/db/src/import.ts ON CONFLICT (slug) DO UPDATE content_hash

conflicts.requested_resolution: Agent 3's canonical export should emit distinct version identity for a changed hash and keep the previous version addressable. Agent 7 will not invent a second slug scheme during integration.
conflicts.note: Stale-approval detection in packages/db/src/coverage.ts can still demote human_verified when the stored decision hash differs from the current row. That does not preserve the previous source version.

conflicts.summary: A human-verified retract from an explicit numeric estimate to a later qualitative withdrawal, with no replacement number, leaves the withdrawn probability inside the public distribution. The withdrawal is excluded as statement_type. Supersession only counts when the retract target is itself an eligible numeric estimate.
conflicts.requested_resolution: Agent 2 defines how a verified withdrawal with no replacement number leaves the distribution, and implements that in the trend engine. Agent 7 will not change forecast semantics on the integration branch.
conflicts.scenario_5_on_same_fixture: A different question key was excluded as question_key_mismatch. That separation already holds on main.

migration_reservation.rule: The first workstream that adds a migration in an included commit claims the next integer. A later workstream rebases onto the next free number on the integration branch. Two files numbered 004 are a mechanical conflict Agent 7 may renumber, recording the original number, the new number, and the owner.
